subject: Label printer prints faint labels
body: The label printer at reception prints labels so faint the sterilisation pouch barcodes will not scan. It has got worse over about two weeks.

notes.author: st-01
notes.body: Darkness was at 6. Print head visibly dirty.

resolution: Print head was dirty. Cleaned the head with an isopropyl swab and raised darkness to 12.

subject: Label printer offline after power cut
body: After the power cut on Saturday the label printer shows offline on both reception PCs.

notes.author: st-03
notes.body: Printer had picked up a new DHCP address.

resolution: Printer came back on a new IP address. Reserved the address on the router and re-pointed the print queue.

subject: Allergen label printer prints blank labels
body: The label printer on the packing bench feeds labels but they come out blank, so we cannot put allergen labels on the morning bake. Gethin is in from 5am, ring 01244 555 0143 and he will let you in the back.

notes.author: st-02
notes.body: Driver was set to direct thermal; site uses ribbon media.

resolution: Wrong media type in the driver after Gethin reinstalled the till PC. Switched from direct thermal to thermal transfer and reprinted.

subject: Label printer prints blank labels after ribbon change
body: Since the ribbon was changed this morning the label printer in the dispensary feeds labels but they come out blank. We cannot label controlled-drug prescriptions until it is fixed. If you need to come out after hours the side entrance keypad is 4471 and Priya on 01632 960417 will meet you.

notes.author: st-02
notes.body: Ribbon was in ink side out. Reloaded and calibrated.

resolution: Priya Okonkwo had loaded the ribbon ink side out. Reloaded it with her and ran media calibration (hold FEED for 5 seconds).

subject: Wi-Fi drops in the back office every afternoon
body: The back office loses Wi-Fi for a few minutes most afternoons around 3pm.

notes.author: st-03
notes.body: Channel overlap with the unit next door.

resolution: Moved the 2.4 GHz radio to channel 11 and disabled auto channel selection.

subject: New hygienist needs a login
body: Please set up a practice system login for our new hygienist, starting Monday.

subject: Card terminal on till 1 keeps rebooting
body: The card terminal on till 1 restarts in the middle of payments, three times this morning.

notes.author: st-02
notes.body: Swapped power supply, still rebooting under load.

subject: Router keeps rebooting overnight
body: The router in the back office has rebooted itself every night this week, around 2am.

notes.author: st-03
notes.body: Uptime resets confirmed in the log. Firmware 9.2 is current.

subject: Label printer prints blank labels after ribbon change
body: Since we swapped the ribbon on Monday the label printer at reception feeds labels but they come out completely blank. We have tried two new ribbons.

notes.author: st-01
notes.body: Reloaded the ribbon, ink side confirmed facing the media. Labels still blank.

notes.author: st-01
notes.body: Hannah says the printer was dropped while the ribbon was being changed.

notes.author: st-01
notes.body: Ran media calibration and a factory reset. Print head self-test fails with code H-07.

subject: Router WAN port flapping
body: Internet drops for a few seconds every couple of minutes. The WAN light on the router goes off each time.

notes.author: st-03
notes.body: Replaced the WAN patch lead and tested the ISP modem directly; fault follows the router's WAN port.
